title: Pouring Station
shareTitle: Pouring Station — Little Helper Pouring Game
description: Pour water, beans, and rice to glowing lines in a calm tactile kitchen made for careful little hands.
learningGoals: Adjust pouring speed and stop at a visible target
Compare the movement and sound of water, beans, and rice
Build confidence through gentle practical-life repetition
interactionModel: choose a material, grab an authored pitcher, move it toward the cup, and tilt to pour; a forgiving target band slows and catches the final amount
feedbackModel: recorded spoken modeling, material-specific responsive sound, visible source and target fill, Maya's encouragement, three star beats, and a no-fail celebration

modes.title: Water
modes.skill: smooth sustained tilt and stopping at a visual line

modes.title: Beans
modes.skill: controlled dry pouring with auditory feedback

modes.title: Rice
modes.skill: fine stop-and-start control with small grains

summary: Tilt a toy pitcher and pour water, beans, or rice to three glowing lines with Maya.
